scientific_limitations: Only the defined six-dimensional family over finite fields of characteristic two is classified, not all centrally essential algebras.
Automorphism counts concern K-linear unital algebra automorphisms, not semilinear ring automorphisms.
The original two F2 forms and their Arf distinction are established prior results; older algebra-automorphism classifications under different terminology may overlap the counting formula.
Field-size-uniform statements rest on the written proof; finite-field code supplies independent small-order checks, not an infinite exhaustive certificate.
Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Quadratic descent and exact automorphism counts for a six-dimensional centrally essential algebra family
